insight: Founded in 2019 by twin brothers Swapnil and Snehal Shinde; raised a $34M Series B in 2021 (Elevation Capital), $47.5M total.
name: Zeni
tagline: AI bookkeeping and finance concierge for startups.
description: Zeni is an AI-powered bookkeeping and accounting platform that pairs machine-learning automation with a team of human finance experts. It categorizes transactions, reconciles accounts, pays bills and runs reimbursements, then surfaces real-time burn, runway and cash metrics on the Zeni Dashboard, with optional fractional-CFO services. It targets venture-backed startups and growing SMBs.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary AI bookkeeping engine paired with human finance experts.

edge: Blends AI bookkeeping with a human finance team plus built-in banking and bill-pay, acting as an outsourced finance department rather than software alone.

references.title: Zeni banks $34M to show SMBs their finances in real time
